sanskrit: gurave ca gaṇeśāya kārtikeyāya dhīmate kārtikeyamasyaivāvighnaparisamāptyarthamabhivandate samuddhṛtya satāṃ dhartuṃ hṛtkaṇṭhaśravaṇe sadā dhartuṃ bindvādīni ratnāni siddhāntasamudrāduddhṛtya kṣantumarhanti tatsanto nāsūyā paricārake ratnāni sūtrairbaddhyante | tasmāt sadārādhanapravṛtte mayyasūyā na kartavyeti īśvarāṇāṃ śivānāṃ ca dhāraṇīyatayā dhiyā ratnānīṣṭavidhānācca bindvādyāḥ śivaśāsane adhvaitatprāptaye ṣoḍhā karṇyate parameṣṭhinā tatprāptaye ca kalādiṣatprakāro'dhvā śivena śāstreṣu varṇyate yogāśca vividhāḥ karma nityanaimittikaṃ yathā etadeva parā kāṣṭhā mokṣākhyāṇorvicārataḥ dhyeyaṃ ca yogamārgeṇa śaktipātoditātmabhiḥ caiṣāmāgamānumānayogipratyakṣa-siddhatvaṃ sūcayati na tābhyāṃ sadṛśaḥ kaścicchreya āptividhāyakaḥ evāvadhāryam āptastu śiva evaikaḥ śivānye tvaśivā matāḥ śivatvaṃ cātra sarvajñatvasarvakartṛtvamabhipretam kāmakāritayā'nyaistu nindyate paśuśāstravat guruṇā dīkṣito yadā | sarvajñaḥ sa śivo yadvat (vi0 1|21) iti hetubhiḥ sādhyate kintu dhanyairāghrāyate sadā ānandavipralabdhānāmānandopahitā citiḥ avagāhya parānandalaharī yadi notkṣipet tadvacanādetanna saṃbhavatītyarthaḥ udakṣeṇordhvavaktreṇa tatastadavadhārayet

vidyeśvarādīnāṃ śāstrāvabodhakatvāt nahyatra śemuṣī śuddhā vipulāpi pragalbhate tasyātmasvarūpasya parīkṣaṇamapi siddhāntoktaireva hetubhiḥ kāryamiti bhāvaḥ trīṇi ratnāni ko vetti siddhānteta vinā svayam tadvad yogaṃ ca ko vetti sabījābījalakṣaṇam sarvān sādhakacittasthānāptaścintāmaṇiryathā phalāvāptiścetyarthaḥ parīkṣā kriyate tatra bindurādau nirūpyate sa binduḥ paranādākhyaḥ nādabindvarṇakāraṇam aprāptaśivadhāmānastridhā vijñānakevalāḥ sāmyāstrividhā eva vijñānakevalino bhavanti tatra vidyābhujaḥ pūrve mantrā vidyāśca nāmataḥ tatra prathame vidyātattvanivāsina ityāha- tatra vidyābhuja iti teṣāṃ purāṇi vidyāyāṃ vāmādīni yathottaram pañcavidhakṛtyādhikāritvāt madhyāḥ praśāntakaluṣā vidyeśāḥ śivatejasaḥ śivārkakarasaṃparkavikāsātmīyaśaktayaḥ tathā purāṇi tatraiṣāmanantaḥ parameśvaraḥ eṣāmananta eva parameśvaraḥ pare sadāśivasamāḥ patikṛtyādhikāriṇaḥ tattvameṣāmasūtāṅgapurabhogādiśobhitam ityuktaṃ śrīmatpauṣkare- sādhakasya tu lakṣyārthaṃ tasya rūpamidaṃ smṛtam iti aṣṭādaśabhiradhvāyaṃ bhuvanaiḥ saha bhoktṛbhiḥ śaktiśivatattvayośca sadāśivatattva evāntarbhāvo vijñeyaḥ sadāśivāditattvaugho nityopādānakāraṇaḥ

eṣo'pi sadāśivādiradhvā vikārī, tato nityopādānakāraṇa iti pārthivo'pi bhavet kumbho māyopādānakāraṇaḥ sākṣānmṛdupādānatve'pi ghaṭasya paramparayā māyaivopādānakāraṇamiti yadyadutpadyate vastu tanmāyeyaṃ yathā kalā āptavākyenāpyetatsiddhamiti bhāvaḥ pariṇāmo hi vastūnāṃ pūrvāvasthāparicyuteḥ dadhnaśca takravat tatra takrāvasthā nirūpyate sadavasthaṃ hi vastvekaṃ pūrvaṃ kṣīraṃ tato dadhi vistareṇa darśitaḥ tattvatāttvikabhāvānāmupādānamanaśvaram ghṛtakīṭanyāyenaikadeśenaiva māyā pariṇamata ityadoṣaḥ na māyā neśvaro nāṇurna śaktiḥ śuddhavartmanaḥ tathāhi māyā yā teṣāṃ kṣobhitā'nantatejasā prabhuḥ (vi0 3|27) iti aviśuddhajaḍatvena māyāmārgatayā tathā sakalāṇūpabhogyatvāt pariṇāmodayairapi niṣpādane kalādīnāṃ śarīrādisamanvitam suvarṇamiva karmāraṃ makuṭotpādakarmaṇi kṣobhyate'nantanāthena kumbhakāreṇa mṛd yathā savikalpajñānaviṣaya eva śarīriṇāṃ kartṛtvaṃ dṛṣṭamiti bhāvaḥ sa tu śabdaścaturdhā vāgvaikharyādivibhedataḥ | tatra śabdopādānatvenāpi bindusiddhiḥ vidyāśarīro bhagavānanantaḥ kṣobhako mataḥ ato na māyopādānaṃ tathaivāyaṃ maheśvaraḥ ātmā śaktiśca vijñeyau vistaro'trai?va vakṣyate

cāsmābhistattvaprakāśavṛttau dṛśyante pudgalāḥ kecidalpajñānakriyānvitāḥ pudgalaścetano nityo vikārarahito mataḥ siddhamāgameṣu śrūyate | ityato'sya na vikāraḥ saṃbhavati tathaiva ca citiḥ śaktistayorapyavikāriṇoḥ vikāritvāt || (ślo0 19) iti | ata eva tayoraupādhikameva vaicitryamityāha- tayorapīti saṃpṛktā cidaṇoryena māyādyarthāvalokane nādākhyaṃ yatparaṃ bījaṃ sarvabhūreṣvavasthitam (1|5) iti na karmaṇā'ṇorvaicitryamanapekṣeṇa jāyate pṛthivyādīnāmapyanupayogāt karmopabhogaṃ kurute vaicitryaṃ candanādayaḥ satyam, sādhanavaicitryadvāreṇaiva karma phalavaicitryaṃ karoti na kevalamityavirodhaḥ pravṛttiḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ tyāgopādānakāraṇam bhūtānāṃ pravṛttiḥ saṃbhavati, nānyathā śivānāmasamaiśvaryabhājāṃ bhogādhikārayoḥ prāhuḥ, aparasya tatra pragamāsambhavāt bindureva vikalpākhyāṃ savikalpakabuddhiṣu na cāyaṃ bhāvanāsaṃjñaḥ saṃskāro'dhyakṣabhāvataḥ na buddheḥ pariṇāmo vā māyordhvamapi sambhavāt savikalpānubhavaḥ siddhaḥ tataḥ sṛṣṭiṃ prakurute savikalpakabodhavān māyākṣobhakatvam, na tu śivasya bindukṣobhavannirvikalpakamātreṇeti bhāvaḥ anye vṛttiparīṇāmabhedavādaviśāradāḥ guravo'nyathā sādhayanti pariṇāmasya kartā'yaṃ na tu vṛttestatastathā

yato'yamanantaḥ pariṇāmasya kartā tatastathāvidhasavikalpakajñānavānityarthaḥ iti jānāti yaḥ śaktaḥ sa kartā pariṇāminām tathāhi sarvo nirdhūtavikalpamavalokayan ityarthaḥ anantenāpi śabdānuviddhavijñānapūrvakam savikalpaṃ vijānāmītyavabodhābhimānataḥ nirvikalpakabodhe'pi bindumīśo'dhitiṣṭhati na vṛttipariṇāmābhyāṃ kartṛbhedo'vadhāryate bindorapi tattvabhuvanādirūpeṇa pariṇāmaśrutervṛttipariṇāmayoratyantabhedābhāvācca śabdatattvamaghoṣā vāg brahma kuṇḍalinī dhruvam bindurevaṃ samākhyāto vyomānāhatamityapi vaikharī madhyamābhikhyā paśyantī sūkṣmasaṃjñitā ata āsāṃ kāraṇatvena binduḥ siddha ityarthaḥ sthāneṣu vidhṛte vāyau kṛtavarṇaparigrahā kevalaṃ buddhyupādānā kramād varṇānupātinī prāṇavṛttimatikramya vartate madhyamāhvayā svayaṃprakāśā paśyantī māyūrāṇḍarasopamā iyaṃ cākṣarabindurūpetyuktam yasyāṃ dṛṣtasvarūpāyāmadhikāro nivartate nivṛttisiddheḥ kevalaḥ paramānando dhīro nityoditaḥ prabhuḥ sarvabhūtāntaracaraḥ śabdabrahmātmako raviḥ tāmeva vāṇīṃ sūkṣmākhyāmāhurātmavido janāḥ jaḍatvāt, tatsamavāye puruṣasyāpi vikāritvā'cetanatvādidoṣaprasaṅgāt ābhyo viviktamātmānaṃ nahi paśyanti pudgalāḥ

tāsvevātmabhrāntiriti bhāvaḥ vaikharī śrotraje bodhe madhyamā savikalpake tasyā api samutpādanahetuḥ paśyantī yadāvṛttiraśeṣeṇa vilīnā cittasaṃśrayā atyantasaṃśleṣāt tadrūpeva bhātītyuktam na so'sti pratyayo'ṇūnāṃ yaḥ śabdānugamādṛte saiṣā caturvidhā vṛttirnivṛttyādikalāśrayāt bindusiddhiriti bhāvaḥ nivṛttiśca pratiṣṭhā ca vidyā śāntiśca pañcamī samastādhvavyāpikāḥ sthitā ityāha- yābhirvyāpto'dhvapañcakamiti tattvādhvā bhuvanādhvā ca varṇādhvā ca padātmakaḥ vyomavyāpisaṃjñaḥ | mantrādhvā punaḥ saṃhitāmantrā eva tyaktvaikamekaṃ saṃprāpya kalādiṣvajarāmaram kalādhvā varṇitaḥ pūrvaṃ nivṛttyādivibhedataḥ sākārakāraṇāmātmabinduśaktiśivāśrayām teṣu kālānalādīnāmanantāṇḍasya ṣaḍ bahiḥ rudrāṇāṃ śatasaṃkhyānāṃ vīrabhadrasya copari ekāśītipadā devī pratisargapadakramāt mantrāvajātahṛdayau tatra sā tu parā kalā pañcādhvano vyāpya teṣveva vartata ityarthaḥ pītaiṣā caturaśrā ca kaṭhinā vajralāñchitā tatpralīnāṇusaṃghasya saṃkalpo vinivartate brahmā'tra kāraṇaṃ mantraḥ sadyojāto'dhidevatā bhūtāni pañca tanmātrāḥ pañca karmendriyāṇi ca avyaktamapi varṇāśca hādiṭāntā vilomataḥ

jalatejo'nilākāśabuddhyavyakteṣvahaṅkṛtau śiro vāmaśca mantrau dvau viṣṇuḥ kāraṇamucyate dhyātavyā galapadmāntarbahulālokaśālinī pratiṣṭhito yatastena pratiṣṭhā nāma sā kalā vidyāyāṃ sapta puruṣo rāgo niyatisaṃyutaḥ māyādibhuvanānāṃ ca vijñeyāḥ saptaviṃśatiḥ padāni viṃśatirmantrau śikhāghorau vyavasthitau sā tu sphuradanekārcistrikoṇā svastikāṅkitā tatpralīnāṇusaṃghasya saṃkalpo'śeṣagocaraḥ śāntau tu trīṇi tattvāni daśāṣṭau bhuvanāni ca padānyekādaśā'trāsan mantrau vaktratanucchadau ṣaṭkoṇoditamalpāntasahasrakiraṇadyutiḥ tatpralīnāṇusaṃghasya dveṣarāgādyabhāvataḥ īśvaraḥ kāraṇaṃ tatra mantrastatpuruṣāhvayaḥ atra ca trīṇi tattvāni pañcamī tu parā kalā varṇā visargapūrvā ye ṣoḍaśa svarasaṃjñitāḥ śāntyatītā ca pañcādhvāgarbhiṇī paramā kalā īśāno mantrarāḍenāmadhitiṣṭhati kāraṇam vyāpako bhuvanādīnāmabhivyāptaḥ sa bindunā sa hi devaḥ samāvṛtya svaśaktyā'nanyabhūtayā ataḥ śakteḥ sarvajñānakriyārūpatvaṃ siddham anyasyānyatra sadbhāvaḥ sarvadā'vyabhicāriṇī dvidhā sā sannidhāvekā paramātmavidhānataḥ yathārko dinaceṣṭānāṃ sannidherupakārakaḥ saṅkalpamātreṇa kartṛtvaṃ dṛṣṭam

vicitraiḥ pariṇāmaistairvidadhāti śiveritaḥ yena yad vyāpyate vastu pariṇāmitayā svayam bindunā vyāpyate yo'sau ṣaḍvidho'dhvā kalādikaḥ binduṃ gamayatīti bhāvaḥ kecidācakṣate binduḥ samavaiti śive tataḥ vyatirikteti bhāvaḥ dve śaktī samavāyinyau śive jñānakriyātmike jñānaśaktyā vijānāti kriyayā kurute jagat śiva ityadhyāhāraḥ tābhyāṃ na virahastasya te ca na staḥ śivaṃ vinā īśā'dhikakriyāśaktyorvidyājñānātiriktayoḥ jñānaśaktyādhikye'pi vidyātattvātmā bhuvanāni vicitrāṇi svabhāvalalitāḥ priyāḥ vidadhāti śivaḥ śakterananyāyāḥ kriyātmanaḥ ato nāyaṃ pṛthak śakteḥ śaktireva kriyātmikā so'yamātmani tattvaughamanekabhuvanāvalim bindurākhyāyate yuktyā pariṇāmī pradhānavat yathā kṣīraṃ jaḍatve'sya samavāyaḥ kathaṃ śive ityāha- jaḍatva iti śivasyānupamākhaṇḍacidghanaikasvarūpiṇaḥ tvacetanatvādidoṣaprasaṅgāt na tasya yuktiḥ śāstraṃ vā nātmā nāsti ca devatā bhogamokṣakartṛtayā devatāpi na siddhyati kriyayā hetubhūtatvāt kriyāśaktiścideva yat kriyāhetubhūtatvād jñānaśaktireva kriyāśaktirucyata ityavirodhaḥ

jāyate'dhvā kutaḥ śuddhaḥ kva vā līyeta kena vā vijñānakevalāstredhā kathaṃ kasmācca te punaḥ nahi cit pariṇāmena kurute tadaśeṣataḥ etatprāgeva darśitam | sādhitaṃ cāsmābhistattvaprakāśavṛttau vistareṇa syādeṣa kalpitānekabhedaḥ kāryaviśeṣataḥ śuddhādhvanastattvabhuvanādibhedaḥ satya eva, anyathopacārasyāpyayogāt māyeyo'pi tathā tu syādadhvā yuktyaviśeṣataḥ prasiddhānadhvanaḥ śuddhān pratyācaṣṭe kathaṃ sudhīḥ durbuddhaya eveti bhāvaḥ pravṛttirupabhogāya mokṣāya ca nigadyate mokṣārthaṃ vā''tmanāṃ pravṛttiryathā'dhikāraṃ dṛśyate prāpyate cittabhedena mokṣo vā'tha catuṣṭayāt śrīmatṣaṭsāhasrikāyāmapi- dīkṣaiva mokṣadā puṃsāṃ cidabhivyaktikāriṇī iti na tatra māyopādānaṃ tanubhogādi jāyate tatra sadāśivapada iti kiñca māyā prayojyena kartrā kenāpyadhiṣṭhitā yathā mṛtkalaśādīnāṃ kulālena tathā hyasau ajño janturanīśo'yamātmakārye'pi kīrtitaḥ prayojyatvāccharīrādiyukto'nantaḥ kulālavat deśādinā sa siddho'dhvā viśuddhaḥ śivaśāsane kalāvyāptasvarūpā ca pudgalādhiṣṭhitā ca yat pariṇatimāhuḥ mahāmāyā bhavet tredhā tatra sthūlā guṇātmikā bhogyāṃśca viṣayān paramparayotpādayantī prakṛtirucyate sūkṣmā kalāditattvānāmavibhāgasvarūpiṇī

mantrayoniḥ parā māyā nityā kuṇḍalinī tu yā nityā, paramakāraṇatvāt kāryātmikā sā māyeyaṃ pariṇāmavatī ca yat viśuddhasyādhvanaḥ siddhiranivāryā'vatiṣṭhate na teṣāmasito mārgaḥ kalāśuddhyā viśuddhyati tattvādīnāmato bindoḥ kāryamadhvā viśeṣataḥ bhāvaḥ anupādānarūpāṇāṃ kalānāṃ nityaśuddhayoḥ ityākhyātā mahāmāyā sarvādhvaprakṛtiḥ parā anye tu kathayantyatra māyāmadhvasvanaśvarīm kalāmutpādayāmāsa (1|6-7) ityādi śuddhiśca tādṛśī jñeyā tayorāgamavedibhiḥ mantrayonirmahāmāyā yā parigrahavartinī proktavannādādidvāreṇā'dhiṣṭhitāḥ seyaṃ kriyātmikā śaktirīśvarī sarvadoditā pāśātītaśivasamavāyeneti paśūn vartayate nityaṃ nānāyoniṣvaniścitā tu nāśuddhayoniprāptirityarthaḥ sā bhogasādhanopāyapratyayodayahetunā sarvathaivāmṛtaprāpteḥ pṛthakkāraṃ pratanvatī karotītyarthaḥ jñānaṃ parāmṛtopāyahetuḥ parikaraḥ paśoḥ nirbījadīkṣāyāmapyācāryasya jñānapradhānatvāt śabdarāśiśca bindūttho bindurnādādasāvapi nādabindvādikrameṇa śabdotpattirityuktam

tatra bhoktṛtayā bhogaiḥ śarīrendriyagocaraiḥ vicchinnāvārakamalānāmeva tatsaṃbhavāt māyaiva kāraṇaṃ śuddhāśuddhayormalakarmaṇoḥ bindorviveke sahasā cchidyate malakambukaḥ saṃbhavāccādhikāramalakṣayastadviveke bhavati uttīrṇamāyamātmānaṃ mahāmāyānuṣaṅgiṇam śarīrādīnyutpādayatītyarthaḥ yathodadhiruparyeva vikarotyanileraṇāt svakāryarūpābhiḥ kalābhiḥ prāguktaṃ viśvaṃ vyāpnoti cetyarthaḥ evaṃ māyaikadeśena vikaroti tathākhilam pragamaḥ saṃbhavatyeva tatrākṣubdhe bhaved bhogo bindāvānandarūpiṇi svarūpaniṣṭhe śakterapyupasaṃhṛtavyāpāratvāllayaḥ ekaiva khalu cicchaktiḥ śivasya samavāyinī tayaitayā'bhisaṃbandhādeko devastridhā bhavet śaktirapratighodāramarīcinicayātmikā nirāvaraṇanirdvandvanirupādānavaibhavā śāntoditaprapañcādibinduvyāptipaṭīyasī ādimadhyāntarahitā rahitā sarvabandhanaiḥ citireva matāmlānamahimā parameṣṭhinaḥ tayaitayā'bhisambandhaviśeṣānnityarūpayā bindurāpūrayannādairāṇavaṃ cinnabho muhuḥ vikaroti yathā lolaiḥ kallolairnādayannabhaḥ ekānekavibhāgeva kāryabhedād vibhāvyate icchākāryamanicchāpi kurvāṇecchā cidavyayā

jñeyakāryādyupādhibhedāt tasyā jñānākriyādibheda ityarthaḥ yad yasyāḥ kāryamāmnāyalokābhyāmavadhāritam kāmānapi bahūnekaḥ kalpavṛkṣaḥ prayacchati tathā'nāhitasaṃskāraviśeṣaikasvarūpiṇī na jāyate na mriyate kṣīyate na ca vardhate utpadyate naśyati vā cinotyapacinoti ca śarīrādi tathā nāsau tasmānnaiṣā vikāriṇī bodhaśakterabodhasya pariṇāmo hi dṛśyate samavāyena tādātmyānnahi cit pariṇāminī śaktirnā'cetanā citaḥ (mṛ0 vi0 3|4) iti sattve kāraṇaśūnyatvādapi binduvadiṣyate asyāścānityatve'navasthāprasaṅga iti bhāvaḥ yatsiddhau jagataḥ siddhiryadasiddhau na kiñcana pramāṇena sādhyate ? kāryotpattyanyathānupapattyaiva sā siddhetyabhiprāyaḥ tāmetāmadvayāmeke kīrtayanti vipaścitaḥ dvaitapratibhāso dvicandrādijñānavad bhrānta eveti yathā rajjurahicchidramālāvibhramakāriṇī jñānamātraṃ tathaiveyamekānekāyate bhramāt vicārāllūnamūlatvādaheturbandhamokṣayoḥ nityamuktādvayānantasaṃvidevāsti kevalam vyavahārastu bhedātmā vijñeyo vaṭayakṣavat bālamūkādivijñānatulyaivākalpanārthajā prāmāṇyābhyupagamād bhedasya ca vikalparūpatvānna pratyakṣasiddhatvamityarthaḥ yad viśeṣaṇavijñānaṃ śabdasaṃskārapūrvakam arthasāmarthyajaṃ jñānaṃ smṛtisaṅkalpavanmatam

pratyakṣa eva tāvarthe vikalpaviṣayāvapi bhedapratibhāsaḥ mucyate tebhya evāyaṃ bandhamokṣau na vastutaḥ gurubhiḥ pratibodhyante siddhāntāgamadāyibhiḥ sādhyeta taireva dṛḍhaṃ tasyāḥ syāt sadvitīyatā bhāvaḥ aprasiddhasya dharmasya siddhyai vyāptyupabṛṃhitāḥ tataḥ pṛthageva bhedena dharmyādayaḥ siddhā abhyupagantavyāḥ siddhyasiddhī ca saṃbhūya naikatra sthātumarhataḥ sādhyasiddhiḥ tadabhāvataḥ prayukto bhedamākhyāti prayogaḥ svāṅgasiddhaye svāṅgasya hetvādeḥ siddhyarthamityarthaḥ dvaitabhāvastato'nyatra siddhyet siddhāvapi dhruvam āgamo'pi tadaistaistaiḥ smāritārthaviśeṣataḥ yadyadvayeyaṃ saṃvittiḥ svena syādabhidhitsitā nivāryamāṇamaṅgaiḥ svairadvaitakṣapaṇakṣamaiḥ vartamānā hi dṛśyante gauṇe'rthe lokavedayoḥ naivaṃ heturaduṣṭāyāṃ vyāptau sādhyaṃ na sādhayet mukhyamapyapahāyārthaṃ nutiṃ kurvanti saṃvidaḥ bhedaṃ parebhyo vyāvṛttirūpaṃ yonopajāyate savikalpamasandigdhaṃ vyabhicāravivarjitam agṛhītārthabhedasya tannāmādiviśeṣavat pāvakamanudhāvediti sarva(masa)mañjasam sāmānye siddhasādhanāt

bhedaḥ siddhyedathānanyabhāva evaṃ ca sādhyate bheda eva sādhyate rajjūdāharaṇaṃ śiṣyasammohāyaiva kevalam rajjūdāharaṇamanarthakamevetyarthaḥ vivartamānā tairbhāvairjñānamātranivartakaiḥ bhogasāmyavimokṣādidoṣaprasaṅgādityuktamasmābhiranyatra maloparuddhadṛkśakternarasyevoḍurāṭ paśoḥ malaruddhajñānaśakterekaiva cetanātmikā saṃvidanekarūpeva vivartata iti ekamindumanekāṃstān bhūyobhūyaḥ samīkṣate api tiktaṃ vijānāti payaḥ karaṇadoṣataḥ viduṣāmapi nīloṣṇapratyayāvavivekataḥ vivartamānā jāteti naṣṭeti vividheti ca tacchivapraṇidhānena śivaśāstroditena ca timirādiryathārogyaśāstroktenaiva karmaṇā abādhitaḥ pramāṇaiśca vivartaḥ syāt kathaṃ citeḥ tasmād vivartate saṃvidaṇūnāmeva bandhanāt atadrūpāpi tadrūparūpiṇīvā'nubhūyate anyonyādhyāsasādhyatvādavivekakṛtodayaḥ āropyātmani tadvṛttivikārānavikāriṇī sasukheti saduḥkheti svātmānaṃ darśayatyaṇoḥ avivekena jānāti bālo'haṃ kṛśa ityataḥ bhrāntipradhānasantānakandaścijjaḍavastunoḥ vivartabhedā yujyerannantarā dṛḍhabandhanam sā ca māyāyā mohakatvādanātmādāvātmābhimānarūpeti aṇoreva na sarveṣāmato bandhastayormataḥ

tayościjjaḍayoranyonyaguṇādhyāse bandha eva niyāmaka iti śeṣaḥ na tāni punaranyasya karaṇāni tayostathā buddhirna sarvā sarveṣāṃ tena bandhastayormataḥ puṃsopabhujyate tena tayorbandho niyāmakaḥ tena bandho'sti bandhaśca pṛthageveśiturmataḥ galite sarvathā bandhe vimukte cāṇave male bandhamokṣaśca śivaprasādādevetyuktam sarvāvaraṇanirmuktā śaktireṣā mahīyasī parasaṃvitsvarūpāyāḥ śakterasati bandhane tathātve muktasyā'pi sukhaduḥkhādisaṃvedanena bhoktṛtvaprasaṅgāt ato vimuktāḥ sarvajñā na tu cinmātravedinaḥ na tu svasaṃvedanamātraniṣṭhāḥ, api tu śivavat sarvajñā eveti tamasācchādyamānā hi na te muktā bhavanti ca jāyate malaruddhānāmaṇūnāmarthadarśane nirvikalpārthasaṃvittistadaharjātabālavat yathārthasthitiṃ gṛhṇāti svasaṃvedyā cidavyayā śaktyādibhiḥ sārdhaṃ paśyatyātmā gatāvṛtiḥ || (ślo0 111) iti nahi kartṛbahutvasya gamakaṃ vidyate kvacit nirvartyamānatvād rāgadveṣādirahitatvācca na pravartante saṃvidāśrayate śaśvacchivaṃ paramakāraṇam tirodadhāti bhagavānanugṛhṇāti cātmanaḥ śaktimānāhitodyogaḥ pravṛttaśceti deśikaiḥ tasmin mukulitevāste kriyākhyā śaktiraiśvarī parabindusvarūpādhiṣṭhāturlayāvasthocyate patyurāviṣkarotyuccaiḥ paramānandasantatim

sukhasaṃvedanarūpo vyākhyeyaḥ, nirmalatvena śivasyopādhibhūtayostayorasambhavāt pañcamantratanuḥ śrīmān devaḥ sakalaniṣkalaḥ ityādinā | eṣo'rthaśca śrīmanmataṅge vistareṇa darśita iti tata evāvadhārayitavyaḥ mantrarūpā hi tacchaktirmananatrāṇadharmiṇī vācakaśabdānāmupacāreṇa mantraśabdaprayogaḥ sā bhāti binduśāntyādipañcādhiṣṭheyagocarā bhogasthānāni pañcaiṣāṃ bindusaṃjñā śiveritā bhogasthānatayetyuktamityavirodhaḥ tadgocarā parā mūrtiraparā kāryagocarā mūrtirityarthaḥ saiva mūrtiḥ kriyābhedāt sādākhyā tanurucyate ityarthaḥ bhogasthānaniviṣṭānāṃ nirmalānāṃ śivātmanām tatkāryaṃ sā kriyāśaktirasāvapi tathocyate icchājñānakriyādyā yatprabhavāḥ kāryayonayaḥ ityarthaḥ dehendriyādayaḥ śuddhāḥ subhagāḥ svadhikārakāḥ tatsaṃbandhācchivo'śeṣakāryāṇāṃ heturucyate patikṛtyādhikāreṣu sadāśivamaheśvarān dhyeyatāṃ prāpnotītyarthaḥ pañcasrotomukhaḥ śāntaḥ prabhuḥ śaktiśirāḥ śivaḥ īśānamūrdhā puṃvaktro daśadigbāhumaṇḍalaḥ pravṛttimānayaṃ devaḥ sakalaḥ sarvapāvanaḥ layabhogādhikāreṣu tau hi cinmātrarūpiṇau svātmani pravilīyante tenaike samadhiṣṭhitāḥ

layāvasthaśivasamatvāllayāvasthābhāja ucyante samāliṅgya mahāmāyāmapare vṛttiśālinīm śāntyādibhuvanarūpeṇa pariṇatāṃ mahāmāyāmāśritya vartanta ityarthaḥ tathā pare paravyoma samāśrityādhvamūrdhani śivājñayā pañcakṛtyakāriṇo bhavantītyuktam tataḥ sa teṣāmeko'pi layabhogādhikāriṇām tadvadeva matā śaktistayorbhedo'dhunocyate samāśrayaḥ sa vijñeyaḥ svaniṣṭhaghanacinmayaḥ dharmadharmitayaivānayorbhedaḥ paramaiśvaryarūpā ca mahimā vyāptirūpiṇī prakaṭayati- tayoriti parānapekṣaṃ rūpaṃ yadvijñānaṃ śivasaṃjñitam parāpekṣaṃ viṣayāpekṣamityarthaḥ ākāradvayasaṃvittiraśeṣasyāpi vastunaḥ svasaṃvedanasiddhatvādetat siddhamityarthaḥ | ataścāsti śaktiriti nityoditānavacchinnavibhūterīśvarasya yat tena śaktiḥ parāpekṣaṃ rūpamīśasya yujyate kāryaputrādirūpāṇāmanyathaivopalambhanāt pitrāderviṣayādisāpekṣeṇaiva jñānādinotpattidarśanādityarthaḥ virodhenātha paryāyānnaivamapyavināśi yat pariṇāmaḥ avināśi ca tannityamiṣṭamasmād vibhidyate kāraṇāt tathā dharmātmikaiva śaktirityarthaḥ kāryopādhivaśācchaktisaṃjñā syādapi cidghane dharmirūpameva paramārthaṃ na tu dharmarūpamityarthaḥ

karaṇena vinā kāryaṃ kurvan kartā bhavediti na śaktyanyat (vi0 3|4) iti | evamātmanāmapi dehaspandādau śaktireva karaṇamityuktam kiñcāgṛhītamapi cedupādhiḥ kāryamīśituḥ kathaṃ vāyaṃ bhavet kartā kāraṇajñānavarjitaḥ idamandhatamaḥ kṛtsnamantarā śaktidīpikām ananyāpi tathā śambhorvibhinnā śaktiriṣyate tādātmyasaṃbandhānnātmāntaravad bheda ityāha- nāpi bhinnokteti ananyā'pi vibhinnā'taḥ śambhoḥ sā samavāyinī nahyeṣa bhagavān śaktyā svātmano'tyantabhinnayā cicchaktiyuktatvenaiva darśanāt anāhitaviśeṣo'pi heturdevo maheśvaraḥ binduḥ pralīnakāryo'sau śivaśaktisamīritaḥ cirasthāpitaviśvo hi bindureva pravartate mṛdavasthāntarāpattyā pūrvamevamasāvapi kāryabhedāya ghaṭate nirvikāre'pi śūlini bhedasaṃśoṣacūrṇānāmavasthābhedajanmanām kartā sargādikāryāṇāmavikāro'pi śaktimān dravatāśuṣkatāheturavikāro'pi bhāskaraḥ aṇūnāmavikāro'pi bandhamokṣakaraḥ śivaḥ karmaṇoḥ sannipātena śaivī śaktiḥ patatyaṇau bhogataḥ || (6|19) iti | malaparipāke satyanugrāhikāyāḥ pātaḥ praśāntamalakāluṣyamātmānamanupaśyati malāvaraṇāpagamāt tadvimuktaṃ sarvajñatvādirūpamasya prakāśata ityarthaḥ nityanaimittikenaiṣa karmaṇā vartate param prāpnuvanti mahādhīrā dhanyā hi śivayoginaḥ

yogābhyāsādatraiva sarvajñatvādiḥ prakāśata ityarthaḥ nadījanapadodyānapurādīni svalīlayā namastathāvidhāyāsmadgurave śivatejase rāmakaṇṭhakṛtālokanirmalīkṛtacetasā ratnatrayaparīkṣārthaḥ saṃkṣepeṇa prakāśitaḥ
